what: Sales home → Data health counts quotations waiting/expired and bad GSTINs across ALL branches (no office or person filter); "Fix ›" then opens a register that does not show them.
rule: docs/02 19l: Sales screens "read the existing records through their own office-scoped readers … nobody sees a record their register would not show".

what: Manager person chips and "Who has what today" list salespeople from other branches (sx_people() is company-wide) and show them with empty counts because their records are outside the manager's scope.
rule: docs/02 19l: a manager may pick another salesperson; nobody sees a record their register would not show.

what: A landline (022 2345 6789) gets a 💬 WhatsApp link to wa.me/02223456789, which cannot work (sx_wa() only adds 91 to exactly 10 digits and accepts any 11+ digits).
rule: docs/05-ui-ux-blueprint.md Zero Training UI — a button must do what it says.

what: Today → Renewals due shows a contract ending today as "in 0 days" while the Renewals screen says "ends today".
rule: docs/05-ui-ux-blueprint.md (plain words, one meaning per screen)

what: Logging "Meeting fixed" (0 days = you pick) without a date is accepted with "No next step set." but the record keeps its old (possibly overdue) follow-up date; the message and Today disagree.
rule: QA-REPORTS/V51/46 §1 (each outcome fills "By when"; 0 = the person picks the date)

what: Deal page Activity list does not show the "What happened" outcome, direction or next step saved by the one log form (lead page does); a log with an empty "Who you spoke to" reads "Telephone call Telephone call".
rule: QA-REPORTS/V51/46 §1 "one form everywhere"; owner 19 Nov 2026

what: /sales-log has no office/branch check: a salesperson can log on, and change the follow-up date of, a lead or deal in another branch they cannot open.
rule: docs/02 19l "Log a conversation … needs leads_can_edit() for a lead or opp_can_edit() for a deal" plus branch scope (docs/02 19c, SALA-004: no edits to another branch's lead).

what: On a phone, Today → 📝 Log scrolls the form to the very top of the screen where the sticky top bar covers "1 · How" and the Call/WhatsApp choices.
rule: docs/05-ui-ux-blueprint.md phone-first for field/sales use

what: Sales → New lead accepts a first follow-up date in the past when sent without the browser's date check (no server-side check), unlike the log form which refuses past dates.
rule: docs/02 19l New lead: first follow-up = next working day; log form refuses past dates.

what: Sales → New lead "Give it to" (and Sales settings "New leads go to") offers salespeople of any branch; a lead given to someone outside its office is invisible to that person (lead lost).
rule: docs/02 19l New lead; docs/02 19g reassignment; branch scope (SALA-001 pattern).

what: Pipeline board "Confirmed orders" counts accepted quotations of every branch and person (no owner/office filter) — 5 / ₹19.8 L for an Ahmedabad salesperson whose Orders & payments shows 4 orders.
rule: docs/02 19l: Sales screens read records through their office-scoped readers; nobody sees a record their register would not show.

what: Sales dashboard → Pipeline by stage shows the stage win % but a weighted figure worked from the deal's own %, so the row does not add up (₹2,00,000 × 10% shown as ₹1,20,000).
rule: QA-REPORTS/V51/45 & owner brief: weighted = value × stage win %

what: Orders & payments shows Accounts (Finance, not a "management" role) only quotations they own — i.e. none — so the accounts person cannot use the screen meant for "Sales + Accounts".
rule: QA-REPORTS/V51/45 §3 (Orders & payments for Sales + Accounts); docs/02 19l

what: Renewals, Today → Renewals due and Sales home "Renewals due" list contracts of every branch (no office filter on partner_contracts), so a Mumbai salesperson sees Ahmedabad customers' contracts and values.
rule: docs/02 19l: Sales screens read records through office-scoped readers; nobody sees a record their register would not show.

what: Renewals shows "🧾 Renewal quote" to people who cannot create quotations (e.g. Finance), leading only to "You cannot create or edit quotations."
rule: docs/05-ui-ux-blueprint.md (no dead buttons)

what: Targets: paise are stored (₹6,00,000.56) but History, the month box and the e-mail show whole rupees (₹6,00,001; "▲ ₹49,999"); a minus figure is silently dropped with no message.
rule: CLAUDE.md "Every financial change is traceable"; docs/05 plain feedback

what: Targets: saving from an older tab reverts every month another manager changed in the meantime (each box is posted and treated as a change), recorded as the second manager's change.
rule: CLAUDE.md "Never overwrite historical or approved records"; owner 19 Nov 2026 target-change visibility

what: Sales settings: an outcome named only in Hindi/Gujarati is saved with an empty key and then silently dropped (not shown on the settings page or the log form).
rule: docs/05 Zero Training UI; CLAUDE.md "Nothing hard-coded" (outcomes are the company's own list)

what: Quote GST split: when "Our state" (Tally/Accounts setting) is not set, the quote says the CLIENT's state is missing even when the client has one; the Company profile state is not used.
rule: docs/02 19l "The quote screen shows how its GST splits … books_is_igst — display only"

what: Client register Sales view → "Last contact" counts automatic system entries (e.g. "Deal opened", status changes) as contact; Today's idle/stale logic excludes them.
rule: QA-REPORTS/V51/45 §1 (last contact column); lib/sales_simple.php sx_last_touch() excludes auto entries

what: Contacts → Buying role accepts any posted value (not checked against the list), and the Masters page for "Buying role (contacts)" says "not on any form yet" although the contact form uses it.
rule: QA-REPORTS/V51/45 §1 (Buying role is an editable list)

what: Switching "Today" off hides four of the six Sales home cards (Overdue, Due today, Overdue payments, Renewals) and the Data health "Fix" links, because they link to Today; the figures themselves are still valid.
rule: lib/features.php header: a switched-off feature is hidden "as a link or button on other screens"; owner: switches must not lose information

what: Sales → Records shows Finance the "Deals" and "Pipelines & funnels" tiles (opp_can_view via Quotes view) but both screens refuse Finance.
rule: docs/05 Zero Training UI (no dead tiles); docs/02 19l (tiles follow the screen's own right)
